BSC20-012.name: The CleverMachineMusha Shiranui
BSC20-012.effect:
[LV1][LV2] Red/Purple/White
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Red/Purple/White Spirit/Ultimate/Nexus/Magic effects.

[LV1][LV2] (Opposing Attack Step)
While [Soul Core] is on this Spirit, this Spirit can block while exhausted.

[LV2] (When Blocks)
This Spirit gains +5000 BP.

BSC20-011.name: The CleverMachineMusha Zantetsu
BSC20-011.effect:
[LV1][LV2] Red
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Red Spirit/Ultimate/Nexus/Magic effects.

[LV2]
While there is [Soul Core](Soul Core) on this Spirit, give all your White Spirits: red.

BSC20-004.name: Bone-Weasel
BSC20-004.effect:
[LV2] (Start of Opposing Attack Step)
The opponent sends a core from a Spirit they control to their Reserve. If there is [Soul Core](Soul Core) on this Spirit, instead, the opponent sends two cores from a Spirit they control to their Reserve.

BSC20-014.name: Fuurin
BSC20-014.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Destroyed by the Opponent)
Return a Magic card from your Trash to the Hand.

BSC20-017.name: Inugami
BSC20-017.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
While there is [Soul Core](Soul Core) on this Spirit, when you use a Magic card, after its effect resolves, draw a card.

[LV2][LV3] (When Destroyed by the Opponent)
By discarding a Magic card from your Hand, this Spirit remains on the Field, refreshed.

BSC20-016.name: Moon Rabbit
BSC20-016.effect:
[LV1][LV2] [Holy Life] (When Attacks)
When this Spirit's attack reduces the opposing Life, put a core from the Void to your Life.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
While [Soul Core] (Soul Core) is on this Spirit, the number of cores put to your Life via your Spirits' [Holy Life] becomes two.

BSC20-021.name: The ArmorFalcon Suiran-Hawk
BSC20-021.effect:
Flash - [High Speed]
This Brave card in Hand can be summoned by paying the cost with cores in the Reserve. In this case, cores to be put on this Spirit must also be from the Reserve.

[When Braved]
While [Soul Core] (Soul Core) is on this Spirit, this Spirit gains an extra Green symbol.

BSC20-009.name: The ArmoredMothShinobi Tobikage
BSC20-009.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Put a core from the Void each to every "Ninja Gale"/"Shellman" family Spirit you control.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
While [Soul Core] is on this Spirit, the opponent can't activate their Bursts.

BSC20-001.name: The BattleArrowDragon Byouha
BSC20-001.effect:
[LV1][LV2] Flash - [Awaken]
You can send any number of cores from your Spirits to this Spirit.

[LV2] (Either Attack Step)
When your other Spirits are depleted via [Awaken], destroy an opposing 4000 BP or less Spirit. Also, if [Soul Core] is on this Spirit, draw two cards.

BSC20-X03.name: The BlueFlamesWisdomKing Agnius
BSC20-X03.effect:
After the opposing Burst activates, you can summon this Spirit card from the Hand, without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2]
Your Bursts can also activate at: [Burst: con] (After your Life is reduced) / [Burst: con] (After your Spirit is depleted/destroyed by the Opponent).

[LV2] (When Attacks)
If [Soul Core](Soul Core) is on this Spirit, destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with a cost equal or inferior to this Spirit's.

BSC20-010.name: The CleverMachineBeast Shoujou
BSC20-010.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Opposing Turn)
When the opposing Hand increases due to any player's effects, put a core from the Void to any of your White Spirits. If there is [Soul Core] (Soul Core) on this Spirit, also, refresh a White Spirit you control.

BSC20-013.name: The CleverMachineBeast Yoroiphant
BSC20-013.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
This Spirit's color and symbol are also treated as Purple.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Return an opposing Nexus to the deckbottom. If [Soul Core](Soul Core) is on this Spirit, also, return an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with a cost equal or inferior to this Spirit's to the Hand.

BSC20-019.name: The Cobalt Mitsumataorochi
BSC20-019.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Either Attack Step)
When your Nexuses become exhausted, destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with a cost equal or inferior to the exhausted Nexus.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] [Assault: 2] (When Attacks)
This Spirit can, up to twice per turn, be refreshed by exhausting one of your Nexuses.

[LV2][LV3]
While [Soul Core](Soul Core) is on this Spirit, all your Nexuses gain +2 cost.

BSC20-003.name: The FerociousDragonGeneral Hagundragon
BSC20-003.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] Flash - [Awaken]
You can send any number of cores from your Spirits to this Spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
Give your Spirit with Soul Core on it +10000 BP.

[LV2][LV3] (Either Attack Step)
When your other Spirits are depleted via [Awaken], refresh this Spirit.

BSC20-002.name: The FlameSacredBeast Homurawolf
BSC20-002.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Destroy an opposing 10000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate. If [Soul Core](Soul Core) is used to pay the summon cost, also, you can summon a Red Brave card from your Hand, without paying the cost.

[When Braved] [LV2][LV3] (Either Attack Step)
When any opposing Spirit is destroyed by your Spirit/Ultimate effects, draw two cards.

BSC20-020.name: The KatanaGeneralArmor Ash-Lion
BSC20-020.effect:
[When Braved] (When Attacks)
The opponent destroys one of their 7000 BP or less Spirits/Ultimates without Soul Core on it.

BSC20-006.name: The Necromancer Mumei
BSC20-006.effect:
Flash - (Either Attack Step)
By using [Soul Core] (Soul Core) as part of the summon cost, summon this Spirit card from your Trash.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Destroy an opposing exhausted 10000 BP or less Spirit.

BSC20-X02.name: The OgreDeity Basara
BSC20-X02.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
For each core on this Spirit, send a core from an opposing Spirit/Ultimate to their Reserve. When a Spirit/Ultimate with Soul Core on it was depleted by this effect, send all the cores from the opposing Reserve to their Trash.

[LV2][LV3] (Either Attack Step)
When your Purple Spirits become exhausted, send a core from an opposing Spirit/Ultimate to their Reserve.

BSC20-015.name: The SengokuPrincess Anko
BSC20-015.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Start of Your Attack Step)
If [Soul Core](Soul Core) is on this Spirit, by putting a Magic card, or a Cost 3 Spirit card from your Hand face-up onto the Remove Zone, draw a card.

BSC20-X01.name: The SengokuGoldDragon Ragou
BSC20-X01.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] Flash - [Awaken]
You can send any number of cores from your Spirits to this Spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Either Attack Step)
When another Spirit you control is depleted via [Awaken], you can summon a Spirit card with [Awaken] from your Hand, without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing 5000 BP or less Spirit.

BSC20-005.name: The SnakeArtsMagician Zuda
BSC20-005.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
When [Soul Core](Soul Core) is used to pay the summon cost, draw a card.

[LV2][LV3]
When any Cost 6 or more Spirit is summoned from your Trash, send cores from an opposing Spirit/Ultimate to their Reserve until only one core remains.

BSC20-008.name: The StrangeFangShinobi Tachikazewolf
BSC20-008.effect:
[Burst: After your Life is reduced]
Summon this Spirit card without paying the cost. If there is Soul Core in your Reserve, also, put two cores from the Void to this Spirit.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Exhaust an opposing Spirit.

BSC20-007.name: The WindDemon Amatsuba
BSC20-007.effect:
Flash - [High Speed]
This Spirit card in Hand can be summoned by paying the cost with cores in the Reserve. In this case, cores to be put on this Spirit must also be from the Reserve.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Refresh a Cost 5 or less Spirit you control. When [Soul Core](Soul Core) is used to pay the summon cost, instead, refresh a Spirit you control.
